te: Louis Jolliet and Jacques Marquette begin exploring the Mississippi River.
dz: 路易·乔利埃特和雅克·马奎特开始探索密西西比河.
de: Louis Jolliet and Jacques Marquette begin exploring the Mississippi River.

t: 一支同盟军的法国和瑞典军队在祖斯马尔斯豪森战役中击败了帝国和巴伐利亚军队.
te: An allied French and Swedish army defeats Imperial and Bavarian forces in the Battle of Zusmarshausen.
dz: 一支同盟军的法国和瑞典军队在祖斯马尔斯豪森战役中击败了帝国和巴伐利亚军队.
de: An allied French and Swedish army defeats Imperial and Bavarian forces in the Battle of Zusmarshausen.

t: 保罗·德·乔梅德(Paul de Chomedy),西德·迈森纳沃(Sieur de Mais…
te: Paul de Chomedey, Sieur de Maisonneuve founds the Ville Marie de Montréal.
dz: 保罗·德·乔梅德(Paul de Chomedy),西德·迈森纳沃(Sieur de Maisonneuve)发现了"维勒·玛丽·德·蒙特雷亚尔".
de: Paul de Chomedey, Sieur de Maisonneuve founds the Ville Marie de Montréal.

t: 祖哈布条约结束了奥斯曼人和萨法维德人长达十五年的战争.
te: The treaty of Zuhab ends the fifteen-year-long war between the Ottomans and the Safavids.
dz: 祖哈布条约结束了奥斯曼人和萨法维德人长达十五年的战争.
de: The treaty of Zuhab ends the fifteen-year-long war between the Ottomans and the Safavids.

t: 丹麦的安妮被加冕为苏格兰女王.
te: Anne of Denmark is crowned Queen of Scotland.
dz: 丹麦的安妮被加冕为苏格兰女王.
de: Anne of Denmark is crowned Queen of Scotland.

t: 亨利八世和安妮博林的婚姻被废除。
te: Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn's marriage is annulled.
dz: 亨利八世和安妮博林的婚姻被废除。
de: Henry VIII and Anne Boleyn's marriage is annulled.

t: 乔治·博林 二世罗克福德等四人被以叛国罪处死.
te: George Boleyn, 2nd Viscount Rochford and four other men are executed for treason.
dz: 乔治·博林 二世罗克福德等四人被以叛国罪处死.
de: George Boleyn, 2nd Viscount Rochford and four other men are executed for treason.

t: 潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯 (Pánfilo de Narváez) 与 600 名男子离开西班牙…
te: Pánfilo de Narváez departs Spain to explore Florida with 600 men – by 1536 only four survive.
dz: 潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯 (Pánfilo de Narváez) 与 600 名男子离开西班牙，前往探索佛罗里达州 — 到 1536 年，只剩下四人幸存。
de: Pánfilo de Narváez departs Spain to explore Florida with 600 men – by 1536 only four survive.

t: 第3任白金汉公爵爱德华·斯塔福德被以叛国罪处死.
te: Edward Stafford, 3rd Duke of Buckingham, is executed for treason.
dz: 第3任白金汉公爵爱德华·斯塔福德被以叛国罪处死.
de: Edward Stafford, 3rd Duke of Buckingham, is executed for treason.

t: 瓦拉几人击败了入侵的奥斯曼军队.
te: The Wallachians defeat an invading Ottoman army.
dz: 罗文之战:瓦拉几人击败了入侵的奥斯曼军队.
de: Battle of Rovine: The Wallachians defeat an invading Ottoman army.

t: 当月早些时候教宗马里努斯一世去世后,选举教宗哈德良三世.
te: Election of Pope Hadrian III following the death of Pope Marinus I earlier that month.
dz: 当月早些时候教宗马里努斯一世去世后,选举教宗哈德良三世.
de: Election of Pope Hadrian III following the death of Pope Marinus I earlier that month.

t: 上月教宗朱利叶斯一世去世后被选为教宗.
te: Election of Pope Liberius following the death of Pope Julius I in the previous month.
dz: 上月教宗朱利叶斯一世去世后被选为教宗.
de: Election of Pope Liberius following the death of Pope Julius I in the previous month.
